text:
Ana (People Ops): FYI — noticed yesterday's bulk sync left a bunch of interviewers with role="unknown" and their scheduler invites failed. Looks systemic, not just a handful. Anyone see this?
ats-sync-bot: Bulk import job 99821 finished with 12 errors, 9 warnings. Error summary: schema mismatch (column shift). Log: https://internal-logs/redwood/ats/99821
Ravi: I pulled the failed rows 2. The CSV preview shows an extra column `region_pref` appended, which pushed `interviewer_role_id` values one column right for many rows.
Maya: can you paste a snippet of the CSV?
Ana (People Ops): sure, redacted sample below:
```
email,first,last,interviewer_role_id,timezone,region_pref
ali@acme.com,Ali,Khan,IR-ENG,UTC-07,us-west
maria@acme.com,Maria,Lopez,,UTC+01,eu-central
```
Priya: that blank `interviewer_role_id` in row 2 used to be the `role` string (e.g., "onsite_engineer") but with the new exporter the fields got reordered.
Connor (Eng): which exporter changed? I thought we versioned the schema.
Ravi: export-team pushed v2.3 last week that included `region_pref` and an optional `role_label` but didn't bump the CSV header ordering in the webhook. That caused the importer to parse columns by position rather than header name in one code path.
Maya: oy. Some interviewers ended up with role_id assigned from timezone values, so the scheduler couldn't map them to templates.
Ana (People Ops): real impact: ~24 interviews with failed invites yesterday; hiring teams pinging us.
Connor (Eng): quick mitigation: update importer to prefer header-based mapping always; fallback to position-only if headers missing. I can make a patch.
Priya: can we also add a short validation step that detects valid `interviewer_role_id` patterns (IR-*) and warns when values look like timezones? That would have caught this.
Connor (Eng): good call. Plan: 1) change importer to header-first mapping + pattern validation. 2) run `./tools/ats_repair --job 99821 --dry-run` to produce candidate fixes. 3) apply patch and run actual repair in maintenance window.
Ravi: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood/ats-importer/pull/820  includes header-first mapping and a sanitization check.
nats-sync-bot: Repair dry-run queued by Connor: task 30312. Expect ~3m.
Connor (Eng): dry-run done  summary: 0 destructive writes, 21 rows auto-corrected by mapping rules, 3 rows flagged for manual review (ambiguious role values).
Maya: great. I'll coordinate with affected hiring managers and resend invites after the real run. We should also update the interviewer training checklist to include "verify exporter header changes with People Ops before deploy".
Priya: I'll update the ops runbook: add a regex sanity-check for role IDs and an automated Slack alert if more than 5 rows match timezone-like values in role column.
Ana (People Ops): thanks. Can someone drop the list of impacted candidate IDs once the real run completes so I can draft comms?
Ravi: will post IDs after maintenance run.
Connor (Eng): scheduling actual repair for 2:30am PDT to minimize disruption. I'll post confirmation in #incidents when completed.
Maya: thanks team  appreciate the fast turnaround. :heart:
